title: Port local chat, proposal, and review workflows
goal: Bring the old local manual-agent/chat workflow into the standalone app with proposal review, current-view sync, pending review events, and guarded apply.
acceptance_criteria: The app has a desktop chat/recommendation affordance connected to a local provider adapter
Selected-text instructions can create hash-checked proposals
Apply/reject stays review-gated and demo-safe until live write mode is explicit
Pending reviews and current-view sync are represented
Developer/debug diagnostics remain available but separate from the main flow
validation: Smoke provider status with a local loopback endpoint
Smoke proposal creation against a small Markdown fixture
notes: Provider shape is resolved: define a provider-neutral local agent interface with an LM Studio/OpenAI-compatible local endpoint as the first adapter. Service-backed document reads are expected to arrive through SG-0013.
